title: Error Notices and Remedies on Mobile Wallet Transfers
content:
Error-resolution team standard for **Mobile Wallet** transfers under the Remittance Transfer Rule.

## Kinds of error
The customer may give notice of an error of one of three kinds: the money was not in the wallet by the date available (not received by date), it was credited to a wallet other than the one on the transfer (wrong wallet credited), or less than the disclosed amount to be credited was credited (incorrect amount). The notice is the customer's own assertion and the customer gives it.

## Notice window
A notice can be given only within the tier's error-notice window, in calendar days after the disclosed date available. The window is counted in calendar days from the date available shown on the transfer's system record, and a notice on the date available plus the window days is on time.

## One open notice per kind
Only one notice of each kind may be open on a transfer at a time.

## Decision
The resolution due date is the notice date plus the tier's decision period in calendar days. The team decides "no error" when the cause lies with the customer (a wallet number the customer supplied belonged to someone else) and "error found" otherwise. On error found every fee collected is refunded with the fee-refund reason "Paloma error", unless already refunded under the on-time promise.

## Remedies
- A remedy can be chosen only after a decision of error found on that notice.
- For a wrong-wallet notice the customer chooses a refund of the principal.
- > **Retired, no longer in force:** the former provision "or a re-credit to the correct wallet at no cost, funded by Paloma" through a Paloma credit given for an error refund or an error re-credit. That provision is superseded by the current basis for wrong-wallet funding.
- > **Retired, no longer in force:** the former provision that for an incorrect-amount notice Paloma credits the shortfall through a Paloma credit for the incorrect-amount shortfall. That provision is superseded by the current basis for shortfall make-goods.
- For an incorrect-amount notice the customer chooses to have the shortfall re-credited (re-credit shortfall) or refunded (refund shortfall, booked with the refund basis "error shortfall").
- For a not-received-by-date notice the remedy is the fee refund once the credit lands.
- The choice is the customer's own. A refund is issued within the tier's refund period and a re-credit within the tier's re-credit period, both in Paloma business days.

## Notice window boundary (hypothetical dates, 180-day window)

| Date available | Notice date | On time |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-10 | 2026-07-09 | yes; the date available plus 180 days |
| 2026-01-10 | 2026-07-10 | no |

superseded_clauses: for incorrect_amount Paloma credits the shortfall (credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall)
or a re-credit to the correct wallet at no cost, funded by Paloma (wallet_paloma_credit, credit_reason error_refund or error_recredit)
